indication: improves ability to pay attention, stay focused on an activity, and control behavior problems; helps organize tasks and improve listening skills
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
mechanism_of_action: changes the amounts of certain natural substances in the brain; works as a stimulant to increase attention and control behavior
side_effects: decreased appetite, dry mouth, sleep disruption, dizziness, stomach ache, increased sweating, headache, nausea, anxiety, weight loss, irritability, slowing of growth in children, seizures, priapism, eyesight changes or blurred vision
unsuitable_population: children with structural cardiac abnormalities and other serious heart problems, patients with a history of drug abuse, pregnant women, children under 6 years old, adults over 65 years old
